<a id="about-these-demos"></a>

## About These Demos

A demonstration book for the ASCII UI layout feature. Each chapter contains one locked `UILayout`
block; pecia renders the stored spec into a drawing at the block's placement. The spec is a small
indented tree, and the generated body is never edited by hand.

The specs are authored through the CLI:

```sh
pecia asciiui add    --book ui-layout-demos --parent <node> --file <spec>
pecia asciiui set    --book ui-layout-demos --block <id> --file <spec>
pecia asciiui remove --book ui-layout-demos --block <id>
```

`asciiui.types` in `clabok.json` maps a generic widget to its project type and always wins over an
explicit generic label; `widget=` stays for a single node that needs a different project type.

## Main Menu

A classic main menu: one bordered panel, a vertical action list and a separator before the quit action.

<!-- asciiui:9199884908051995921 -->

```text
Asteroid Belt Inn

+----------------------+
| Main Menu            |
| [ New Game ]         |
| [ Continue ]         |
| [ Settings ]         |
| -------------------- |
| [ Quit ]             |
+----------------------+
```

<a id="ship-loadout"></a>

## Ship Loadout

Two bordered panels side by side; a row stretches the shorter panel so both columns close on the same
line. The summary below is a third panel.

<!-- asciiui:9199884908051995909 -->
```text
Ship Loadout

+----------------+  +----------------------+
| Weapons        |  | Shields              |
| 2 Slots        |  | 1 Slot               |
| [ Laser Mk I ] |  | [ Shield Generator ] |
| [ Empty ]      |  |                      |
+----------------+  +----------------------+

+------------------------------------------+
| Summary                                  |
| Hull 120                                 |
| Cargo 12 t                               |
| ---------------------------------------- |
| [ Save Loadout ]                         |
+------------------------------------------+
```
<!-- /asciiui:9199884908051995909 -->


<a id="settings-menu"></a>

## Settings Menu

One panel per group, so every menu section has its own frame; the form primitives stay inside their
section.

<!-- asciiui:9199884908051995912 -->
```text
Settings

+----------------------+
| Audio                |
| [ ] Enable music     |
| [ ] Enable effects   |
| -------------------- |
| ( ) Master volume    |
| ( ) Voice volume     |
+----------------------+

+----------------------+
| Display              |
| ( ) Fullscreen       |
| ( ) Windowed         |
| Resolution           |
| - item 1             |
| - item 2             |
| - item 3             |
| [ Custom width     ] |
+----------------------+

+----------------------+
| Actions              |
| [ Apply ]            |
| [ Reset ]            |
| [ Cancel ]           |
+----------------------+
```
<!-- /asciiui:9199884908051995912 -->


<a id="trade-window"></a>

## Trade Window

A two-column market row with closed panels, a wallet panel below and the generated legend.

<!-- asciiui:9199884908051995915 -->
```text
Trade

+----------+  +-------------------+
| Offers   |  | Details           |
| Iron Ore |  | Iron Ore          |
| - item 1 |  | 42 credits        |
| - item 2 |  | [ Buy ]  [ Sell ] |
| - item 3 |  |                   |
| - item 4 |  |                   |
| - item 5 |  |                   |
+----------+  +-------------------+

+---------------------------------+
| Wallet                          |
| 1 250 credits                   |
| ------------------------------- |
| [ Close ]                       |
+---------------------------------+

Legend:
- Offers: Panel
- Iron Ore: List
- Details: Panel
- Iron Ore: UILabel
- 42 credits: Value
- Buy: UIButton
- Sell: UIButton
- Wallet: Panel
- 1 250 credits: Value
- separator: Separator
- Close: UIButton
```
<!-- /asciiui:9199884908051995915 -->


<a id="widget-overrides"></a>

## Widget Overrides

`asciiui.types` in `clabok.json` names the project type for a generic kind and always wins over an
explicit generic label, so every button becomes `UIButton` without touching a spec. `widget=` stays
for a single node that needs a different widget type; here the contact list uses `UIListView`.

<!-- asciiui:9199884908051995918 -->
```text
System Map

+---------------------------+
| Map                       |
| [ Jump ]                  |
| Status                    |
| [image: Radar]            |
| Contacts                  |
| - item 1                  |
| - item 2                  |
| - item 3                  |
| - item 4                  |
| [ Zoom In ]  [ Zoom Out ] |
+---------------------------+

Legend:
- Map: Panel
- Jump: UIButton
- Status: UILabel
- Radar: UIImage
- Contacts: UIListView
- Zoom In: UIButton
- Zoom Out: UIButton
```
<!-- /asciiui:9199884908051995918 -->
